items.reason: A gentle cleanser with no actives keeps young skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports comfort and softness, since the moisture score is moderate.
A mineral SPF 50 is the one daily step that suits young skin and protects it from the sun.

response.routine_note: Retinol, vitamin C and the 30% peel are made for adult skin and are too strong for someone under 13, so we've left them out; your skin scores already look healthy and don't call for anti-aging products. Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, add sunscreen in the morning, and ask a parent or guardian to check in with a pediatrician or dermatologist if you have any skin concerns.
